detail.longDescription: I spent a long time thinking about AI agent security the wrong way. We obsess over what agents say. Prompt injection. Jailbreaks. But an agent I was debugging made a call to an endpoint it had no business reaching. No alarm fired. Everything worked as designed. That unsettled me. The model is not the perimeter. https:// praveenlavu.com/dispatch/the-n etwork-security-principle-ai-deployment-gets-wrong/ # AIAgents # Security # Infosec
